payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Mission Status Read API: mission detail, work packages and artifacts on issue-957-mission-status-read-api-mission-detail so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.

payload.wp_title: [PR A] P1 Campsite: extract lookup, read model and head projection (C-011); starts after the #5529 re-cut
[PR B] P13 (1/2) CI, native, nightly and README
[PR A] P1a Stream seam behind the inbound port (operator ruling A3 items 1 to 3)
[PR A] P3 Resolved Work Package state in the reduction (FR-020, NFR-009)
[PR A] P1b Generalised inbound-adapter gates (ArchUnit rules 3, 3b, 1c, 2d, 13, 14)
[PR A] P2 Contract models and build spike (FR-015, D-79)
[PR A] P3a Resolved-state mapping (FR-020, documentation only)
[PR A] P5 Primitives: text-read port, read fence, redaction (FR-007, FR-008, FR-011)
[PR A] P7 Java harness for the detail classes and provisioning (FR-014 Java half)
[PR A] P4 Oracle extension, goldens and the paired Java census (FR-014 Python half, D-109)
[PR A] P4b resolved-state goldens (FR-020 oracle half)
[PR A] P8 Inbound ports, rules 15 and 16, admission gate, Problem mapping, shared wiring (FR-013, FR-022)
[PR A] P6 Decoders and the Work Package index (FR-006)
[PR B] P10 getWorkPackage and promptMarkdown (FR-002, FR-009)
[PR B] P13 (2/2) Full-flow, port-level, coverage-floor and perf tests
